name: dg-dict-app
description: Dict.Dhamma.Gift as a Capacitor Android app. A thin shell around https://dict.dhamma.gift (capacitor.config.json -> server.url): the UI stays the site's, and the app adds only what native can do — launcher shortcuts built from the lookup history, the app version and the store link. This replaces the Bubblewrap TWA that used to live in dg-twa/dict-app: standalone display and the burger panel were broken there because a Trusted Web Activity runs inside Chrome's Custom Tab, not in a WebView this app owns.

scripts.sync-android: npm run build && cap sync android
